title: porpax jerdoniana
intro: Porpax jerdoniana, commonly known as Indian coral tree or coral tree, is a medicinal plant species belonging to the Asclepiadaceae family. The plant has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and skin conditions, due to its health benefits in reducing inflammation and improving respiratory functions. The therapeutic actions of Porpax jerdoniana include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to the presence of bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. Further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using Porpax jerdoniana for medicinal purposes.
